Tie function metadata to the retained runtime and compute evidence digests from its declared metadata; fabricate no fallback digest/source/function. Show the chosen function and editable input/output/upstream mappings before binding. Do not infer Gmail formatting from field names or silently supply personal destinations/templates. Qualify the exact local Udon successor and its catalog offline before Ramen adoption. # M152 — Explicit local-function authoring

**Owner:** ramen; no active stage. **Parallel-safe:** no.
**State:** Accepted and retired; both tasks complete; whole review 2 PASS. Committed baseline `47007e7efe2025cb52e747b3252a6ad42657abfe` was clean.
**Planning approval:** Owner “I approve”, 2026-10-28, for the complete standalone
Ramen / Udon commit review — 2026-10-28 reconciliation plus Kinet W25/W26. Planning only; no implementation,
commit, launch or grant activation.
**Specification:** M152 specification in this retired record.
**Depends on:** Ramen M151 accepted; Udon M60 exact local successor qualified.
**M151 handoff:** M151 qualified shared run-data/preflight merge, selected
source security and staged transactional materialization. M152 must preserve
those checks and use explicit local-function metadata without live models or
providers. The owner subsequently authorized the bounded local Udon successor
pin and exact Vite/Vitest acquisitions described in the specification.
After M151 retirement, the coordinator refreshed Kinet's remaining-goal
reference; raw SHA256 is
`2d7a2fff2403ab56375f8c1997a77f524e3f9d806ccb1c1f3fc693f57bf6c05e`.
**Lineage:** M144's local formatting capability and M147.5's removal of the implicit formatting handler; M149's structure stays retained.
**Provenance and finding ownership:** The specification records source priorities,
local severities, exact baseline/current identities, clean-worktree evidence and
single-owner assignments. Evidence source is Ramen / Udon commit review — 2026-10-28 (review.md); it is
untrusted review evidence, never authority.
**Authorization:** See the owning specification; declarations are not duplicated
here. Future execution must start from committed planning and approved inputs.

## Tasks

| Item | State | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| M152.1 — Restore an explicit supported function choice | `[+]` | Exact Udon M60 successor adopted; explicit declared function binding and mapping controls implemented; fresh Sol/xhigh task review 8 PASS. |
| M152.2 — Qualify the inspector and backend journey | `[+]` | Add positive/refusal component and backend coverage for read -> selected formatter -> send using fake data/providers, including missing metadata, invalid function choice and edited mappings. Reuse unchanged retained-runtime evidence only with checked identities. Run full Go checks, required make ui-build and make ui-check with unchanged-lock offline restoration only when ready, relevant affected checks, and reviewed matching embedded assets. Complete docs, task/whole reviews and handoff. |

## Acceptance and verification

Both supported local functions can be explicitly selected and bound from the inspector; mappings remain inspectable/editable. No heuristic selection, fabricated identity, live send or new authority is introduced. Component/backend journey and required embedded-asset qualification pass.

Keep golight budgets and Node>=22.12 policy. Use installed compatible Node/npm and the unchanged lock; npm ci uses existing verified cache, offline mode and disabled install hooks/audit/update traffic. Missing payloads block UI gates. Run focused DOM/backend tests, GOWORK=off make check, make ui-build, make ui-check and git diff --check; applicable race checks remain required. No physical browser or real provider/model.

The specification owns the full write set, compatibility/downstream contract
and required task/whole review and closure gates. Preserve unrelated work,
retired records, old denials/UNKNOWNs and disabled audit. The combined proposed
launch lives in Kinet's tabilet/memory-bank/suggested.txt; reading it activates
nothing. No source publication or installed-consumer adoption is claimed.

## Review

Review gate iterations: 2

Task review 1 found three P2 issues in function mapping edits, whole-body
output lowering and upstream alias selection; corrections and focused checks
were made. Fresh Sol/xhigh task review 2 found three further P2 issues in
nested input edits, literal whitespace and hyphenated response keys; these
were corrected with component diagnostics and an actual offline retained-runtime
chain. Task review 3 found two further P2 issues in expression-like literals
and hyphenated input names; both were corrected and their original retained-
runtime reproductions now pass. Task review 4 found two further P2 issues:
global literal decoding could alter native UWS values, and data input discovery
misread hyphenated inputs and expression-like literals. Decoding is now scoped
to explicitly marked function operations; input derivation uses reviewed
mappings. Task review 5 found runbook/preflight input discovery disagreed
with these semantics; both are aligned and an integrated generated-project
preflight test passes. Task review 6 identified a caller-supplied-plan
catalog-validation bypass and function-editor state carrying between steps or
projects. Both were corrected and regression-tested. Task review 7 found
that required contract field names could not be edited independently and
legacy literal input discovery changed; both were corrected and tested. Task
review 8 PASS without P1/P2. M152.2 preliminary review 1 raised
test and race-gate gaps; those were addressed, and fresh task review 2 PASS.
Whole review 1/10 FAIL found new function mappings could lose literal whitespace or input punctuation; corrections passed affected task review 10. Whole review 2/10 PASS with no P1/P2.
This is standalone intake, not a continuation of a retired closing gate.

## Verification attempts and authority

The retained aff5c2c runtime had no public identity descriptor, so the owner
approved Udon M60's exact local successor. M60 accepted and retired the
catalog; Ramen adopts `c7e360ddb48a271204ac4ecb5de7f552aafb3738`. Its
[handoff](../../docs/m152-local-functions.md) records local-only provenance.

Initial offline npm restoration failed ENOTCACHED: locked Vite/Vitest and
then 15 Linux x64 transitive payloads were absent. The owner explicitly
approved the two named packages, and later answered “yes” to acquisition of
the 15 exact tarballs in `/home/peter/Workspace/.p16-local-pins/m152-missing-locked-npm.tsv`
(SHA256 `2462c86114a42f5b732b3483eee4e295b24306692f4c0b5fffbff7ea77fd42a9`).
All seventeen were checked against lockfile SHA-512. A disposable offline npm
ci restored 179 packages; the unchanged lock, offline mode and disabled hooks,
audit and update traffic governed subsequent UI gates. Earlier runs with
Vitest 5.0.0 were diagnostics, not acceptance evidence. No other network,
live provider/model, browser, sudo, SSH, push or deployment was authorized.
